reported_success.quote: The replicated coefficient for Model 4 (Coeff = 3.15294, SE = 0.93269, p = .000724) is in the same (positive) direction and statistically significant at the .05 alpha level using a two-tailed test. ... The Wald z-test (z = 0.3009763, p = .7634325) was not significant at the .05 alpha level.

notes: Identity: header identifies SCORE Report - BERSANI_Criminology_2013_zmYY - Adamkovic - 6zz3k.docx, source https://osf.io/download/5869t/. Paragraphs 1–4 identify a primary data-analytic replication report by Matúš Adamkovič, Ivan Ropovik, Gabriel Baník, SCORE RR ID 6zz3k, OSF Project https://osf.io/8ndcx. These project/report identifiers match the neutral reference and supplied URL. Reference creator list differs from report team; reference date is not established by this text. Paragraph 68 identifies the document itself. Results and materials sections establish a primary report rather than an abstract or preregistration. No PDF was supplied. Original side is an unassigned placeholder; no original paper was inspected. Target unresolved: description, study identifiers and locators are blank. There are two claims and multiple tests; neither row order nor numeric matching can assign one. Main candidates: g82z5k paragraph 26 Coeff = 1.77594, SE = 0.73020, p = .015011; moyz3d paragraph 32 Model 1 Coeff = 1.8426, SE = 4.2527, p = 0.66482; Model 2 Coeff = -1.945834, SE = 3.773693, p = .60611; Model 3 LMER Coeff = -0.448171, SE = 0.228581, no p printed; Model 4 Coeff = 3.15294, SE = 0.93269, p = .000724. Paragraph 35 complex comparison Wald z = 0.3009763, p = .7634325. Main significance criteria specify two-tailed tests. Coeff and Wald z are printed labels, not converted effects; standardisation cannot be inferred from ser_method. Sensitivity candidates: paragraphs 40–41 unweighted g82z5k Coeff = 1.408436, SE = 0.627478, p = .02479; moyz3d Models 1–4 Coeff = 1.8713, -1.51495, -0.457999, 2.70014; respective p = .64986, .61488, unprinted, .000861; Wald z = 0.1972861, p = .8436036. Paragraphs 45–46 LMER g82z5k Coeff = -0.071007, SE = 0.061165, no numeric p and internally contradictory narrative; moyz3d Models 1–4 Coeff = 0.017282, - 0.131587, - 0.448171, -0.005894, no individual numeric p; Wald z = -0.05878419, p = .953124. Paragraph 49 ever-married subset without excluding never-arrested participants: Coeff = 2.31487, SE = 1.13681, p = 0.0417. Report gives no analytic participant or observation counts for candidate tests. Years are temporal coverage, not N. No mutually exclusive final groups are counted; no arithmetic is supported. Paragraph 76 lists separate complete output dar_bersani_output.html, not supplied or acquired. Authors describe significant positive simple-test results and a nonsignificant complex comparison, with some contradictory sensitivity findings; a row-specific narrative verdict is unresolved.
